sn30.7-16:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn30.7-16:1.3: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn30.7-16:1.4: idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena dvayakārī hoti vācāya dvayakārī manasā dvayakārī
sn30.7-16:1.8: aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyanti.
sn30.7-16:1.19: so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
sn30.7-16:1.20: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
